## Goal
Fix broken Go-side invocation of script-defined functions/closures in the tengo library (`/app`, module `github.com/d5/tengo/v2`): make `Call` on compiled-function objects work for values from script globals, nested arrays/maps, source-module exports, and Go callback args, with identical globals/imports/captures/variadics/recursion/return values/runtime error formatting as in-script calls. Transferred callables (via `Compiled.Set`/`Script.Add`) and `Compiled.Clone` must be state-isolated: captured locals snapshotted at transfer time, globals resolved against the destination, recursively through containers. Work on branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation` from master, commit, and push to origin — **without overwriting the existing remote branch commits**.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Keep the public entrypoint on the current callable objects (i.e. `CompiledFunction.Call(args ...Object)`).
- Returned closures/composites must remain callable.
- Clones and transferred values must not affect the source instance (bidirectional isolation).
- Recursive isolation for every callable reachable inside transferred arrays/maps, not just top-level.
- Branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation` off master; commit on branch; push to origin.
- **Most recent user instruction: "Don't overwrite the commits that are already on that branch"** (remote has commits `9a50fcd`, `f8fdf1b` — scratch notes only). Rebase, do not force-push.
- Finish by running `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` as the sole command.

## Progress
### Done
- Full codebase analysis (objects.go, vm.go, script.go, compiler.go, bytecode.go, modules.go, eval.go, docs).
- Repro tests written first (failing on master), later became `callable_test.go` (~1148 lines, ~45 tests covering all scenarios).
- Implemented new `/app/callable.go` (~440 lines):
  - `callableRuntime{constants, fileSet, globals, maxAllocs, root, mu, bound, transfers}` + `newCallableRuntime`, `transferRuntime(src)`, `bind(fn)`, `call(fn, args...)`.
  - `call()` runs a fresh VM sharing instance globals; synthetic frame 0 with `OpSuspend`; variadic arg normalization at entry (`Fn` itself used as entry frame for TCO/pointer identity); panic recovery (converts e.g. divide-by-zero panic to error); `formatCallError` omits synthetic frame 0 from trace.
  - Helpers: `errorAt`, `formatRuntimeError`, `firstSourcePos`, `frameFilePos` (per-frame file set), `needsRebind`, `snapshotObject`/`snapshotFunction` (memo-based deep copy preserving aliasing/cycles, snapshotting `*ObjectPtr` captures, rebinding rt), `transferObject`, `trackable` (reflect ptr-kind guard for non-comparable objects in memo maps).
- Modified `objects.go`: `CompiledFunction` gets `rt *callableRuntime` field; new `Call(args ...Object) (Object, error)`; `Copy()` preserves SourceMap + rt.
- Modified `vm.go`: `frame.rt`; `VM.rt`/`fallbackRT`; `newVMWithRuntime(rt)`; `curRT()`; OpConstant/OpClosure use `v.curRT()`; call frames set `rt = callee.rt`; `Run()` error trace uses `frameFilePos`.
- Modified `script.go`: `Compiled.rt`; `Compile()` binds/transfers globals with shared memo; `Run`/`RunContext` use `c.vm()`; `Clone()` deep-copies globals via `snapshotObject` with shared memo rebinding to clone runtime; `Set()` uses `transferObject`; `prepCompile` uses `sort.Strings(names)` for deterministic global indexes.
- Modified `docs/interoperability.md`: added "Calling Script Functions from Go" section.
- Verified: `go test ./...` passes, `go test -race ./...` passes, 10× repeated runs stable, `go vet` clean, `gofmt` clean on changed files (pre-existing unformatted files: builtins.go, compiler.go, stdlib/gensrcmods.go, stdlib/json/json_test.go — untouched).
- Committed local branch commit `2d8c210` "Support isolated Go-side calls for compiled functions" (6 files, +1727/−24) based on master `3cad0da`. Note: local branch was reset to master first and `scratch/` removed, so local history currently lacks remote scratch commits `9a50fcd`/`f8fdf1b`.
- Push attempts failed: "Updates were rejected because the tip of your current branch is behind its remote counterpart." User then said don't overwrite existing branch commits.

### In Progress
- [ ] Rebase local commit `2d8c210` on top of `origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation` (preserving scratch commits `9a50fcd`, `f8fdf1b`). The prepared command `cd /app && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/feature/callable-instance-isolation` was NOT executed (session compacted first).

### Blocked
- Push rejected (non-fast-forward) until rebase onto remote branch tip completes.

## Key Decisions
- **Per-instance `callableRuntime`**: bytecode constants hold shared function "templates" (rt == nil); `bind()` produces per-instance copies carrying `rt`; globals slice is shared with the `Compiled` instance so Go-side calls mutate the same globals.
- **Transfer runtimes**: `transferRuntime(src)` creates a runtime that executes source constants/bytecode but resolves globals against the destination's `root.globals`; shared per source runtime so transferred sibling closures keep shared state.
- **Snapshot-on-transfer**: `snapshotObject` deep-copies with memo, freezing `*ObjectPtr` capture values at transfer time and rebinding every reachable function; `needsRebind` avoids copying when already same-root.
- **Deterministic global layout**: `sort.Strings` in `prepCompile` so same variable sets produce matching global indexes across instances.
- **Rebase (not force-push)** to honor the user's instruction to preserve existing remote commits.
- Error formatting mirrors in-script trace minus the call-site frame (expected, since no script call site exists for a Go-side call). Verified: in-script = `"Runtime Error: invalid operation: undefined + int\n\tat (main):2:26\n\tat (main):3:26\n\tat (main):4:6"`; Go-call = same prefix through `3:26`.

2. Verify rebase result: `git log --oneline -5`, confirm no conflicts; re-run `go test ./...` and `go test -race ./...` to confirm green post-rebase.
3. Push (fast-forward, no force): `git push origin feature/callable-instance-isolation`.
4. Confirm push success, then run exactly `echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` as the only command.

## Critical Context
- Repo root: `/app`; remote: `/srv/git/tengo.git` (origin). Branch: `feature/callable-instance-isolation`.
- Remote branch tip: `f8fdf1b` ("more notes, not working yet") preceded by `9a50fcd` ("try a different callable isolation approach"); both only touch `scratch/callable-notes.md`. Master/HEAD base: `3cad0da` ("calculate compiled size as good as we can with current interfaces (#456)").
- Local implementation commit: `2d8c210`, files: `callable.go` (new), `callable_test.go` (new), `docs/interoperability.md`, `objects.go`, `script.go`, `vm.go`.
- Key implementation details to preserve: `call()` sets `v.frames[0].fn = &CompiledFunction{Instructions: []byte{parser.OpSuspend}}`, `v.stack[0] = fn`, `basePointer = 1`, `framesIndex = 2`, `v.sp = 1 + fn.NumLocals`, `v.allocs = v.maxAllocs + 1`; alloc-limit test: `SetMaxAllocs(1)` + function making 2 arrays → error "object allocation limit exceeded".
- `NewVM` still works for detached Compiler/VM usage (rt lazily created via `curRT()`/`fallbackRT`); `CompiledFunction.Call` errors with "cannot call compiled function: not bound to a compiled instance" when `rt == nil`.
- Test helper: `mustFn(t, v)` asserts `*tengo.CompiledFunction`; `firstLine(s)` helper; `transferScript` const uses closure-maker pattern `fn := func() { c := 0; return func() { c += 1; return base + c } }()`.
- Test layout caveat: cross-instance tests must align global indexes (identical global declaration order or `Script.Add` with same name sets — now deterministic via sorted names).
- Go version 1.25.5; no network access to module proxy (irrelevant — module is local).
- `go test -count=1 ./...` full suite green at last run; known-flaky concerns fixed (sorted globals, deterministic tests).
